subject: Short-term SOC 2 reviewer rotation, token TTL and emergency deprovision plan
messages:
From: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@orionaudit.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short SOC 2 reviewer access (Mar 22-24)

Hi Grace,

We have a short window for a targeted SOC 2 Type II review for Orion Cloud Services and need temporary access to your trust portal. Two external reviewers will need view + download access to the SOC 2 artifacts for the period Mar 22-24 (UTC).

Requirements from our side:
- One-time access links or ephemeral reviewer accounts (no persistent logins)
- IP allowlist to only permit logins from our audit lab (list provided below)
- Download privileges for report bundles and evidence PDFs (read-only for logs)
- A signed bridge letter confirming the audit period and coverage for Mar 1–Mar 31, 2026

IPs: 54.210.12.33, 18.205.45.10

Can you confirm you can provision this and provide a deprovision timeline (we need assurance accounts/tokens will be revoked immediately after the window)? If useful, we can stagger reviewer start times to reduce concurrency.

Thanks,
Sara Lloyd
Senior IT Auditor
Orion Audit

--

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@orionaudit.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short SOC 2 reviewer access (Mar 22-24)

Sara — thanks for the details. We can support this and I want to propose a conservative approach to balance auditor needs and our security posture: 

Plan (high-level)
- Create two ephemeral reviewer accounts scoped to the SOC 2 viewer role.
- Provision one-time SSO links that expire after the window; token TTLs are configurable.
- IP allowlist applied at the session layer for the specified IPs.
- Schedule a staggered start: Reviewer A begins 2026-03-22 08:00 UTC, Reviewer B begins 2026-03-22 12:00 UTC to reduce contention.
- Automated deprovision: tokens/accounts revoked immediately at 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC.
- We will provide a signed bridge letter template you can approve.

Next steps for you: confirm the exact reviewer emails and whether you prefer SSO (IdP) or one-time links. Also confirm the final IP list.

I'll loop in Priyom to confirm technical constraints and the exact TTL we can offer. Attaching a short guide for the portal invites.

Grace O'Connor
Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@orionaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short SOC 2 reviewer access (Mar 22-24)

Quick technical note — we can do ephemeral reviewers with the following constraints and automation: 

- Default reviewer token TTL is 48 hours for the viewer role. For this engagement we can:
  * Issue 72-hour links but implement a rolling-revoke job that rotates credentials every 24 hours with a 2-hour overlap to avoid cutting sessions mid-review.
  * Or issue 48-hour links and script a second short-lived re-issue if the reviewer needs an extension.
- IP allowlist enforced at the session proxy (we will log attempts and alert on mismatches).
- Deprovision runbook: 
  1) At 2026-03-24T23:59:00Z run revoke-tokens --tag orion-mar22
  2) Confirm no active sessions and then delete ephemeral accounts 15 minutes after revocation.
  3) Generate a post-audit activity log snapshot and store in the encrypted evidence bucket.

I will prepare the ephemeral-proxy rotation script and the revoke job. If you want the rolling-revoke approach, mark it in your reply and I'll stage the job in prod with a canary.

- Priyom
Lead Infra Engineer, Security
Redwood Inference

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short SOC 2 reviewer access (Mar 22-24)

Sara / team — confirming schedule and next steps from Redwood's side:

- We will issue two one-time SSO links on 2026-03-22 at the staggered times Grace proposed. Links will be timeboxed and bound to the reviewer email you provide.
- We will apply the IP allowlist you supplied and monitor for anomalies.
- We will run the revoke-tokens job at 2026-03-24T23:59:00Z (UTC). Accounts will be removed 15 minutes after the job completes.
- Bridge letter: attached is our standard draft. Please review and flag any edits; we can sign and return by EOD 2026-03-15 if that works for you.

Emergency deprovision: If during the engagement we see suspicious activity we will revoke access immediately and notify you and Orion.

Attached: Bridge_Letter_Signed.pdf (will send final signed copy once you confirm the draft)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
